what: Large thin-serif title with each letter in its own overflow-hidden mask cell. When the reference (the title or its section) top edge passes the screen center, each letter rises from 100% below its cell over 1s, with a random delay between 0 and 1s (in 5ms steps). Opacity releases .125s later than that delay, over .75s, so letters rise one by one from all over and assemble the name. When the reference goes back below center (scrolling back up), they scatter with the same delays and hide below the cell. Delays are redrawn every time it opens.

options.spread: Range for picking letter delay (s), default 1
options.dur: Time for letters to rise (sec), default 1 — phone (980px or less) original .8
options.fade: Duration (s) for the transparency to clear, default .75 — phone original .55
options.lag: Amount transparency lags behind position (s), default .125
options.y: Hidden position (% of cell height), default 100%
options.by: Ancestor css to measure against (e.g. section) — makes the title rise when the section passes the center. Default is the element itself
options.toggle: If once, after rising once it does not hide again when scrolled back. By default it hides when scrolled back up
options.on: With load, it rises as soon as it attaches, with state, the consumer adds and removes is-in on the element
options.--fx-dur · --fx-fade · --fx-lag · --fx-y: Same value via css (when giving different values per width)
